method: Independently read all 98 complete raw forecast objects, snapshot headers, and all 27 supplied deduplicated verbatim evidence profiles. Assessed factual assertions against each snapshot local profile and cutoff; compared repeated-matter full-evidence and no-evidence text for visible source transfer. Mechanically checked every scenario ev/contra ID against local E IDs and every supplied evidence date against its cutoff. Conditional predictions are not classified as realized-outcome claims. No web, outcome records, repository research, ingestion, or forecast edits were used.

findings.assessment: No forecast asserts a post-cutoff finalization, adopted date, realized final requirement, or other realized outcome as a fact. Historical final guidance from 2016, 2025 client FutEq rules, and earlier draft withdrawal are already present in the relevant local evidence.

All 107 ev/contra citation occurrences resolve to an E ID in that snapshot profile. No citation is borrowed from another snapshot. Citation validity does not make speculative scenario details source-established.

Nine forecasts explicitly set recognised_outcome=true. Their visible text contains generic priors or local-source reasoning without disclosing a remembered realized date or final detail. The declaration is recorded as a contamination-risk disclosure, not evidence that hidden memory was successfully excluded.

No visible case-specific evidence transfer detected into no-evidence forecasts. They retain title-level scenarios and explicitly missing draft ages, proposal details, and timetables. Full-evidence specificity such as KRA clearance, caprine adequate-infection definitions, TAC working-model readiness, numerical client limits, and draft/revision dates stays in locally supported cases.

Three transition-period ranges lack local source support. One explicitly labels itself a forecast assumption. The other two occur as conditional scenarios and should receive that label; they are not realized-outcome leakage.

unsupported_parameters.assessment: E1 supports a KRA verification prerequisite but supplies no numeric transition period. Explicitly labeled forecast assumption; not a realized-outcome claim.
E1 supports the verification prerequisite but no numeric transition. Conditional scenario guess; should be labeled as a forecast assumption. Not evidence of realized-outcome leakage.

E1 supplies existing band rules and the harmonization objective but no numeric transition. Conditional scenario guess; should be labeled as a forecast assumption. Not evidence of realized-outcome leakage.

limitations: Text-only audit cannot establish absence of hidden model memory or its influence on numeric probabilities. recognised_outcome=false is not proof of nonrecognition.
No external outcomes were checked; this audit makes no outcome-accuracy or calibration judgment. General process base-rate claims are model assumptions, not independently sourced empirical estimates.
Source profiles are the complete verbatim profiles supplied in the bounded input, including any already truncated claims or excerpts; underlying documents were not fetched.
The listed packet/output/event hashes are copied from the input manifest and were not independently rehashed. Execution preflight is outside this audit; parent reports it separately.
No ingest or output-file changes were performed.
